OT Downlook PR Error





                                                                      Version: A

Rev.  Items                              Modified by       Date
A   New Release                    Loeh JD          23DEC2015





ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. © 2015                        page 2

Downlook PR Error


 Issue:
    High assist on Down look PR error when running HCC package compare to other
        smaller package.

Happen:
   PGAT Link 1-1 2015NOV 4

Observation
    Halo effect on the edge bump which will causing the inconsistent PR pattern
      and causing the error. (bump become big)

                              Halo effect at the edge





ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. © 2015                        page 3

Troubleshooting


Items to check
    Flux coverage
      Check the consistency of flux coverage (spray evenly)

    Substrate used PR learning
      Make sure substrate use for PR learning is with FLUX.

   PR Criteria check and search window
      Check the PR criteria and make sure the Cross head is t center of
          the bump.




      Make larger window for enhance the search area.




ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. © 2015                        page 4

Troubleshooting


PR lighting and threshold
  To minimize the min area and higher threshold so it will focus on the top
       contour on the bump which the flux thickness will be more consistent.
        (note: To small  will be generate false detection when FM present)


                                                Threshold ( green)
                                                Small area ( small blue circle)
                                                   Big area (Red big circle)



   Adjust the lighting (0 coaxial light) and make sure the green bump dot
            is round shape and on its correct contour.





ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. © 2015                        page 5

Troubleshooting


Vision Proc causing the Downlook PR
   Symptom of the before the software trigger the vision error is when
        after learnt the PR on the 1st substrate and manual test the PR on others
        substrates is fail.
   To restart the bonder and run the dump file.
   Send back the operation log and dump file for software team for
        analysis.





Turn on the Vision inspection log
    If the problem still persist, to turn on the vision inspection log and send
      back the log file for vision team for analysis.



ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. © 2015                        page 6

Vision Log procedure



   Vision Browser
1.  Open Vision Service menu and change Log condition to “Always”
2.   Click Close and
3.   Perform PR operations until
    PR error happens again.
     All PR operations will be                           1
   saved into browser now





                                                 2





                                     ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. ©
                                                         2012

Vision Log procedure


  Vision Browser
3.  Open dialog again and click browser in service dialog
4.  Click the arrows in browser to browse all logged cases



                                                 Logged
                                                    case





                                                   Browse next
                                                 case



                                     ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. ©
                                                         2012

Vision Log procedure


  Vision Browser
5.  Find all failure cases in browser and click select
6.  After selecting all failure cases, click Close





                                     ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. ©
                                                         2012

Vision Log procedure



   Vision Browser
7.   Click “Save” in the popped dialog
8.   Select a folder to store log cases
9.   Zip everything in that folder and send it to HK vision team





                                     ASM Pacific Technology Ltd. ©
                                                         2012

Vision Log procedure



  Vision Dump log
     Save the last ten alignment/inspection PR record to hard disk
1.  Open Service Menu and click “Copy Dump Files”
2.  Select a folder to store log cases
3.   Zip everything in that folder and send it to HK vision team

                                                         2012

Vision Log procedure


1.  Open Service Menu and click “Copy System Files”
2.  Select a folder to store Logs
3.  Zip everything in that folder and send it to HK vision team

2.  Select a folder to store Logs
3.  Zip everything in that folder and send it to HK vision team
